text:
marta: Hey team, drafting the release note + internal blast for tonight's canary (EU). Need quick ops + legal ack before I schedule.

marta: RN draft: "Model service: KV cache warmup reduces cold-start token latency (~30% p95). Canary will pin model v2.1.3; auto-fallback to v2.0.9 on overload. SDK clients: auth-header change is opt-in behind a feature flag. Private EU customers: data processed in-region per residency settings."

ben: Added details for RN: expose warmup metrics (warmup_ms, warmup_count), link to perf dashboard, and SDK PR link.

nora: Ops plan suggestion: start canary at 4% traffic for 8m, evaluate error budget and latency. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.4% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >1400ms for 3m. Ramp to 25% only if both error and latency look stable. I'll handle the ramp.

marta: Thanks. Nora, can you paste the exact deploy commands you'll run?

nora: Commands:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02-c --traffic 4% --notes "kv-warmup, sdk-flag"
/deploy ramp eu-1 --to 25% --after 8m --if healthy
```
And emergency rollback:
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary emergency rollback"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02-c for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:45:00Z; queued by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

ben: ACK 44d infra dashboards + alerting wired to canary-alerts@pager. I'll pin the perf panels.

marta: Legal, need wording check for EU residency line.

legal-bot: legal-bot: automated check passed; recommend adding "retention" wording if customers care about storage.

marta: Updated RN line to: "Private EU customers: in-region processing and retention per configured residency settings." Legal OK?

legal-bot: legal-bot: wording approved.

marta: One-line internal blurb to post ~30m before window: any volunteers to craft?

ben: How about: "Canary rn-2026-04-02-c: model v2.1.3 -> 4% EU, ramp to 25% if healthy. Oncall: infra/ben, ops/nora. Rollback if errors >1.4% (5m) or p95 >1400ms (3m)."

nora: That looks good. I'll add a short runbook note to disable the SDK flag if we see auth regressions.

marta: Great. I'll update the release-notes doc, schedule the internal notify, and set deploy-bot to fire 30m prior. Tagging @eng-oncall and @ops in the blast.

ben: Quick reminder: include the SDK PR link in the RN and mark the SDK change as "opt-in - breaking change for some clients" so PMs see it.

marta: Will do. Final check F4AC please thumbs if OK so I can proceed.

ben: 44d

nora: 44d

legal-bot: legal-bot: signed-off.

marta: Thanks all 680 scheduling pre-flight ping and will hit deploy-bot 30m before window.
